summary: Discusses issues in giving the ECN field in the IP header meanings other than those in RFC 3168. It sets requirements so such alternative uses can coexist safely with routers that follow the original behavior. This is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: Routers use two small flag bits to say the road is getting busy. If someone wants those flags to mean something else, this note explains how to do it without confusing everyone else.
